title: Image resizer service leaks memory
description: The image resizer restarted every few hours with out-of-memory errors.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Root cause: every request created a new image processing instance and never released it.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Fixed by reusing a small pool of instances and releasing them after each resize.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Gotcha: the container memory limit is 512Mi, so the leak only showed up after about six hours. Test long runs, not just single requests.
